rca_of_the_issue: Root cause of user's 'bounced back to login' was that browser dropped the access_token cookie because it was Set with SameSite=Lax;Secure=False inside an HTTPS cross-site iframe (the preview UI). Modern browsers require SameSite=None;Secure for any cookie to be sent in such cross-site contexts. The fix in set_auth_cookies() (server.py:275-277) and the /api/auth/refresh path (server.py:349) now sets secure=True, samesite='none', httponly=True. Verified via curl that Set-Cookie now reads 'HttpOnly; SameSite=none; Secure' and via browser that login → dashboard navigation persists and survives a reload.
